# Resolved for Python 3.12, the version the PythonAnywhere virtualenv is built
# on. Every entry is either named in requirements.in with a reason or pulled in
# by one that is; the comment on each transitive line says which.
#
# `pip install -r` does not remove anything. A package dropped from this file
# stays in an existing virtualenv until pip-sync or a rebuild.
